The current implementation, specifically in OpenCode, is too strict. It is always interrupted because of blockers, errors, or permissions.

A fresh phase child may repair only its own invalid continuation pair. The /auto orchestrator still must not write or repair docs/engineering/state.md or handoffs/resume_brief.md (DEC-0153). RESUME_BRIEF_AUTO_REFRESH=0 stays absolute. Hard security denies for .env and secrets stay hard stops. Do not add a critic Task role. Spawn tech-lead for /sovereign-critic.
Contract tests cover continuation vs security-hard stop.
The operator is not asked to restart the session for those cases.
